description: This file defines constants and functions related to plugin path management within a build or plugin system. It provides utility functions to construct directory paths, file paths, and callsite references for plugins based on plugin IDs and relative paths.

methods.name: bundledPluginRoot
methods.description: Constructs the root directory path for a plugin given its plugin ID.

methods.name: bundledPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs the full file path to a plugin file given its plugin ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginRoot
methods.description: Constructs the distribution directory path for a plugin based on its ID.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs the full distribution file path for a plugin given its ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledPluginCallsite
methods.description: Creates a string representing the callsite location within a plugin file, including line number.
